title: croton lucidus var. glandulifer
intro: Croton lucidus var. glandulifer, commonly known as the Chinese Croton, is a type of plant that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering fever, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve circulation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Croton lucidus var. glandulifer include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
